rationale.acquisition: Finding the right boat among decoys is half of the job, but not more than the landing itself.
rationale.landing: Landing on a moving deck is the core task.
rationale.wind: A single stress factor; it is also part of every combined mission.
rationale.waves: A single stress factor; it is also part of every combined mission.
rationale.combined: Wind, waves, a 100 m search and decoys at once: the condition the drone would actually face, and the hardest test.
rationale.speed: Success matters more than how fast it comes.
